notes.title: vr / environment
notes.notes:
Hopeful that I will be able to get full VR functionality completely bugtested - and also try to get in more environments into the game.

Problem is each environment is very large in size, so I would need to find a way to optimize the environment with level of detail settings or other optimizations. Will be visually stunning, but difficult to implement, if only for optimization alone.

[img]http://i.imgur.com/ukrQ7bX.gif[/img]
